title: Host capacity
description: One record per production host per connector run: the host's memory use, 5-minute CPU p95 and disk use, read from a monitoring source over a 5-minute window (#2935). The Datadog connector emits it from the metrics query API (GET /api/v1/query, timeseries_query permission) for the hosts in the operator's production tag scope: memory from system.mem.pct_usable, CPU p95 computed by the connector from system.cpu.idle points, and disk as the fullest device's system.disk.used / system.disk.total. A reading is present only when it was read; a missing one means the source did not supply enough data for it. Routed by evidence type (#2924): a record reaches every control whose queries declare this kind. The connector's result is always inconclusive; the control's query decides. Metric values only: no dashboard, monitor, log or tag beyond host and device is collected.

source_vendor.description: The monitoring source the readings came from.

host_name.description: The host's name in the monitoring source (Datadog's host tag). It is the host key; it is not Fleet's host_uuid, and no join to osquery.host_posture.v1 is made.

host_role.description: The host's role. The Datadog connector reads only hosts in the operator's production scope, so every record it emits is production.

host_role_source.description: What made the host production, e.g. datadog_scope:env:production.

window_start.description: Start of the 5-minute window the readings cover.

window_end.description: End of the window. The latest reading per host is the one with the latest window_end.

memory_used_percent.description: Physical memory in use, as a percent of the total, at the window's latest point. Datadog: (1 - system.mem.pct_usable) * 100.

cpu_p95_5m_percent.description: Nearest-rank 95th percentile of CPU use over the window. Datadog: computed by the connector from 100 - system.cpu.idle at a 15-second rollup; absent when the window has fewer than 10 points.

cpu_sample_count.description: How many CPU points the window held, whether or not a p95 was taken.

disk_used_percent.description: Disk in use on the host's fullest device, as a percent. Datadog: max over devices of system.disk.used / system.disk.total * 100; absent when any device has no usable total.
